title: WestJet Flight Attendants Strike Over Pay, Affecting Thousands
summary: Flight attendants at Canada's WestJet airline went on strike after union talks failed, leading to the cancellation of 309 flights. The strike impacted approximately 250,000 travelers. The Canadian Union of Public Employees, representing 4,400 flight attendants, announced the strike. WestJet is majority-owned by Onex Corp. The airline began parking Boeing 737 jets in anticipation of the strike. A tentative deal was later reached, ending the brief strike.
summary_points: WestJet flight attendants, represented by the Canadian Union of Public Employees, went on strike.
The strike occurred after union talks failed.
Approximately 309 flights were cancelled, impacting 250,000 travelers.
WestJet began parking Boeing 737 jets in preparation for the strike.
A tentative deal was reached, ending the strike.

एक अंतरिम समझौता हो गया, जिससे हड़ताल समाप्त हो गई।
